items.title: 14.2 Air pollutants (hawa ko ganda karne wali cheezen) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.2, printed pages 306-307.

blocks.text: Pollutants woh cheezein (gases, liquids aur solids) hain jo environment (mahol) ke liye harmful (nuqsan dene wali) hain. Air pollutants (hawa ko ganda karne wali cheezen) ko do types (qismon) mein baanta jata hai: primary aur secondary.

blocks.title: Primary pollutants
blocks.text: Primary pollutants woh cheezein hain jo seedhi bante hain ya hawa mein emit (chhore) hote hain, jaise volcano (aag aur lava ugalne wala pahar) ke phatne se nikli raakh (ash) ya gari ke exhaust se nikli carbon monoxide gas.

blocks.title: Secondary pollutants
blocks.text: Secondary pollutants woh hain jo primary pollutants ke aapas mein chemical reactions se bante hain.
Sab se important pollutants yeh hain:

items: Nitrogen ke oxides (NO aur NO₂), mil kar NOₓ kehlate hain
Sulphur ke oxides (SO₂ aur SO₃), mil kar SOₓ kehlate hain
Heavy metals (bhari metals): Pb, Hg aur Cd

blocks.caption: Primary aur secondary pollutants
rows: seedhe hawa mein emit hote hain
volcano ki raakh, exhaust ki CO, SO₂, NO, PM
primary pollutants ke reactions se bante hain
ozone, PAN, acid rain ke acids

blocks.prompt: Ground level ozone aur sulphur dioxide mein se kaun sa secondary pollutant hai?
blocks.explanation: Sulphur dioxide primary hai, kyun ke yeh coal aur oil jalne se seedhi hawa mein aati hai. Zameen ke qareeb wali ozone secondary hai, kyun ke yeh dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs ke reactions se hawa ke andar banti hai.

items: Primary pollutants seedhe emit hote hain; secondary pollutants primary pollutants ke reactions se bante hain.
Gyarah important pollutants: COₓ, NOₓ, SOₓ, hydrocarbons, low altitude O₃, CFCs, PAHs, POPs, VOCs, PM, heavy metals (Pb, Hg, Cd).
